title: Slide Layouts, Text Boxes & Objects
description: Learn PowerPoint slide creation, title/subtitle placeholder editing, image graphic insertion, and deck ordering.
objectives: Create new presentation slides
Format slide titles and body text boxes
Insert shapes, icons, and picture placeholders

steps.title: Creating Presentation Decks
steps.content: PowerPoint presentations consist of ordered slides. The Home tab provides 'New Slide' controls to choose between Title, Section, or Two-Content layouts.

steps.title: Interactive Challenge: Add a New Slide
steps.content: Click the New Slide button on the ribbon tab to expand your pitch deck.
steps.hint: Click the 'New Slide' icon on the Home tab ribbon.

quiz.question: Which shortcut key starts a PowerPoint slide show presentation from the beginning?
quiz.explanation: F5 launches the slide show in full screen from slide 1.

title: Visual Themes, Color Palettes & Backgrounds
description: Apply color themes (Sapphire, Emerald, Sunset), solid/gradient slide backgrounds, and font pairs.
objectives: Select pre-designed slide themes
Apply gradient background styles
Match font color palettes across all slides

steps.title: Visual Design Themes
steps.content: Themes define the overall color scheme, background styling, and font choices for your pitch deck with one click.

quiz.question: Which ribbon tab allows you to change the global Theme color scheme of a PowerPoint file?
quiz.explanation: The Design tab houses global visual themes, color variants, and background styles.

title: Slide Transitions (Morph, Push, Fade)
description: Configure slide switching effects including Fade, Push, Wipe, and seamless 3D Morph transitions.
objectives: Apply slide transition effects
Use Morph for smooth object movement across slides
Adjust transition timing and sound effects

steps.title: Seamless Motion with Morph
steps.content: Morph transition seamlessly animates matching objects, shapes, and images between consecutive slides.

steps.title: Interactive Challenge: Preview Slide Transition
steps.content: Click the Preview Transition button on the PowerPoint editor toolbar.
steps.hint: Click 'Preview Transition' above the slide canvas.

quiz.question: What makes the Morph transition special in PowerPoint?
options: It automatically tracks and smoothly animates matching objects between two slides
quiz.explanation: Morph analyzes object shapes and positions across slides, animating movement fluidly.

title: Entrance, Emphasis & Exit Animations
description: Animate individual text bullet points, chart elements, and graphic icons step-by-step.
objectives: Apply Entrance animations (Appear, Fly In, Zoom)
Configure Animation Pane sequence ordering
Trigger animations 'On Click' or 'After Previous'

steps.title: Step-by-step Bullet Point Animations
steps.content: Animating bullet points keeps your audience focused on your active talking point instead of reading ahead.

quiz.question: Which tool pane allows you to reorder, time, and inspect all animations on a slide?
quiz.explanation: The Animation Pane displays the complete sequence timeline of all animated objects.

title: SmartArt, Diagrams & Infographics
description: Convert plain bullet points into visual SmartArt flowcharts, hierarchy org charts, and infographics.
objectives: Convert text lists to visual SmartArt graphics
Design organizational charts and process steps
Insert editable vector icons and 3D models

steps.title: Visual Storytelling with SmartArt
steps.content: SmartArt transforms text lists into professionally designed visual diagrams, timelines, and organizational hierarchies.

quiz.question: How can you convert a bulleted text list into a diagram quickly in PowerPoint?
options: Delete the text and draw circles
quiz.explanation: Right-clicking any bulleted list offers instant 'Convert to SmartArt' diagram layouts.

title: Slide Master & Corporate Branding Templates Pro
description: Master Slide Master design templates, logo placement, custom font defaults, and layout placeholders.
objectives: Customize global layouts using Slide Master view
Position corporate logos on all slides automatically
Save custom PowerPoint template (.potx) files

steps.title: Slide Master & Branding Pro
steps.content: Slide Master allows you to place company logos, headers, or color schemes once, automatically applying them to every slide in the presentation.

quiz.question: Where can you insert a company logo so it appears automatically on every slide?
quiz.explanation: Editing the Slide Master propagates changes globally to all dependent slide layouts.

title: Video Export, Voiceover & Presenter Mode Pro
description: Record audio slide voiceovers, utilize dual-screen Presenter View, and export presentations as 4K MP4 videos.
objectives: Record slide show narration voiceovers with laser pointer
Use Presenter View to view speaker notes during presentation
Export presentations as MP4 video files

steps.title: Recording & Exporting Pitch Decks
steps.content: Record Slide Show records your voice, laser pointer movements, and webcam video, producing a standalone MP4 video presentation.

quiz.question: Which view mode displays your speaker notes and upcoming slide preview on your laptop while projecting full-screen slides to the audience?
quiz.explanation: Presenter View provides speaker notes, timers, and next slide previews on your private screen.
